title: Scaling as parents changes

design.question: As parents changes (everything else as the default graph), how much money does each society need, and does the gap between traditional and OSO grow?
design.compare: 4 societies on 4 difficulties (parents 1, parents 2, parents 3, parents 4)
design.fixed: the simple model: 12 identical agents, equal money each round, no mint, no validation
design.measure: money needed to solve half the targets
design.runs: from the sweeps tagged "one at a time 2026-10-24: parents"

answer: To solve half the targets, traditional needs 3.7× to 7.0× the money OSO needs. By difficulty: parents 1 3.7×, parents 2 7.0×, parents 3 6.8×, parents 4 6.6×.
caveats: Read off between the two budgets that bracket half the targets, in log budget.
Each difficulty has its own budget range; "> x" means not reached within it.
